name: Files
summary: Browse, read, edit, and preview every file in your home-scoped roots — and ask an allowlisted agent seat to edit alongside you, live.

screenshots.alt: The Files everything-editor in LinkPix-dark: a roots + folder-tree rail on the left and a file preview on the right

surface.hint: Read, edit, and preview your home-scoped files; ask an allowlisted agent seat to edit alongside you

verify: The box's shared serve-shell (the runtime provider on :8789 — not shipped in this package) serves this surface at /files.html and it renders

Compare the canonical installed source at ~/studio/apps/files against the box's served surface: repair (copy the canonical source in) ONLY if the box surface is missing, provably broken, or provably older than the canonical source; if the box surface is newer (forward drift) leave it untouched and report; if relative age or health is ambiguous, leave it untouched and report to the box lead agent — take no destructive action

verbs.purpose: List a file root's folder tree (the browser rail)
Read a file's contents or preview metadata
Serve a raw file (image, video, or binary preview) with range support
Search file names across the home-scoped roots
Read the current agent-navigation target the open view follows
List the tag ledger for a root
Point the open view at a file (agent-driven navigation)
Write a file — edit and save, with a backup taken on write
Add or adjust the home-scoped file roots (guarded: inside home, never a keys or secrets directory)
Send a prompt to an allowlisted agent seat — the ask-the-agent rail, roster-guarded by the shell
